title: Reading vector
description: A test vector of reading (section 8 of the text of the part): tables, each perhaps with the table of the release before, and what section 5 gives. A reader implements section 5 and gets exactly this.

table.description: The table as YAML reads it: any value, not only one the schema accepts.

previous.description: The table of the release before, which consent-age.ages-kept reads: a table its schema accepts. Left out when that release has no consent-age/.

accepted.description: The reader accepts the table. Left out when it refuses it.

refused_by.description: The step that refuses the table: the schema, or the ID of the rule. Left out when the reader accepts it.

items.description: A path of the table, a country as countries.<code>, or an entry as countries.<code>.<index>.

names.description: Every name that step gives, in the order of code units.
